definitions.explanation: The scientific study of celestial objects, space, and the physical universe as a whole.

examples.japanese: {天文学|てんもんがく}に{興味|きょうみ}があって、{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I'm interested in astronomy, so I bought a telescope.

examples.japanese: {古代|こだい}から{天文学|てんもんがく}は{発達|はったつ}してきた。
examples.english: Astronomy has developed since ancient times.

examples.japanese: {天文学|てんもんがく}の{最新|さいしん}の{発見|はっけん}について{読|よ}んだ。
examples.english: I read about the latest discoveries in astronomy.

notes:
BRANCHES AND RELATED FIELDS:
・{宇宙|うちゅう}{物理学|ぶつりがく} (astrophysics)
・{惑星|わくせい}{科学|かがく} (planetary science)
・{宇宙|うちゅう}{科学|かがく} (space science)

RELATED VOCABULARY:
・{天文学者|てんもんがくしゃ} (astronomer)
・{天文台|てんもんだい} (astronomical observatory)
・{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう} (telescope)
・プラネタリウム (planetarium)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{天文学|てんもんがく}を{研究|けんきゅう}する (to research astronomy)
・{天文学|てんもんがく}の{歴史|れきし} (history of astronomy)

NOTE: The character {天|てん} means 'sky/heaven' and {文|もん} here refers to patterns or phenomena, so {天文|てんもん} literally means 'celestial patterns.'
